A candlestick chart visualization tool that displays Apple Inc. stock price data using Apache ECharts and shadcn UI components.

The project was developed as a part of my BSc in course project at the University. It was a collaborative effort with my team members, and I played a key role in the backend development using NodeJS and ExpressJS, as well as implementing real-time features using Web Socket. The app includes features such as interactive tutorials, code examples, quizzes, and a community forum for discussions. IICT-SUST is a comprehensive web application designed to facilitate the management of student information, course details, and faculty data for the Institute of Information and Communication Technology (IICT) at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology (SUST). The application features a user-friendly interface that allows students to register, view their courses, and access faculty information. Faculty members can manage their profiles and courses efficiently. The backend is powered by NodeJS with PostgreSQL as the database, ensuring robust data handling and security. The application also integrates Nodemailer for email notifications and Cloudinary for image storage.
: Fine Tuned Yollow Model, Roboflow, NextJS, Dataset, Notebook, Kaggle

The Lemon Leaf Disease Detection is a web application that uses a fine-tuned YOLO model to detect diseases in lemon leaves. The application is built using Next.js and utilizes the Roboflow platform for model training and deployment. The dataset used for training the model is sourced from Kaggle, ensuring high-quality data for accurate disease detection.

The application allows users to upload images of lemon leaves and receive real-time predictions on whether the leaves are healthy or affected by diseases. The fine-tuned YOLO model ensures high accuracy in detecting various diseases, making it a valuable tool for farmers and agricultural professionals.

Developed a console-based Snake game using C++ and the Graphics.h library, featuring classic gameplay mechanics, dynamic levels, and engaging user interaction. The game allows players to control the snake, collect food, and grow in size while avoiding collisions.

The Waste Management App is a mobile application designed to facilitate the management and recycling of waste materials. It provides users with a platform to report waste issues, find recycling centers, and learn about proper waste disposal methods. The app integrates with Firebase for data storage and retrieval, and it uses Google Authentication for secure user login.
